endorsements.name: Andrea Cappa
endorsements.label: CVE-2021-28807
endorsements.description: A post-authentication reflected XSS vulnerability has been reported to affect QNAP NAS running Q’center. If exploited, this vulnerability allows remote attackers to inject malicious code. QNAP have already fixed this vulnerability in the following versions of Q’center: QTS 4.5.3: Q’center v1.12.1012 and later QTS 4.3.6: Q’center v1.10.1004 and later QTS 4.3.3: Q’center v1.10.1004 and later QuTS hero h4.5.2: Q’center v1.12.1012 and later QuTScloud c4.5.4: Q’center v1.12.1012 and later
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 7.7)

povs.explanation: A published CVE record provides public, independently verifiable recognition of the credited vulnerability disclosure.

endorsements.name: Andrea Cappa
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-1007
endorsements.description:
In OpenVSX version v0.9.0 to v0.20.0, the 
/user/namespace/{namespace}/details API allows a user to edit all 
namespace details, even if the user is not a namespace Owner or 
Contributor. The details include: name, description, website, support 
link and social media links. The same issues existed in 
/user/namespace/{namespace}/details/logo and allowed a user to change 
the logo.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 4.0, 6.9)
